versions.name: Ransburg
versions.address: 7599 E Waldrip Creek Rd Bloomington, Indiana 47401

features.note: An emergency shelter on the property.
Stocked with souvenirs, Scouting items, and snacks.
Situated on Lake Monroe within Hoosier National Forest.
Open boating sessions alongside swimming and paddleboarding.
Mountain bike treks setting out from the Sports Shelter.
Open sports including badminton and human foosball.
Open handicraft time to work on projects and art mediums.
Open climbing sessions for extra practice.
Open rappelling, restricted to youth participants.
Ransburg's Nature Center, covering native wildlife and plant life.
Trail rides from the camp ranch.
Mad Science, with different experiments each day.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The page is not recently updated, which is fine here: it is used for durable description, not sessions or fees. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
